title: White Sand Vol. 3
summary: The conclusion of the White Sand trilogy brings the political and magical conflicts of Taldain to a head. Kenton makes difficult choices about the future of the Diem and his own role in Lossand—must the sand masters remain servants of the Taishin, or can they forge their own path? Khriss uncovers the truth about the Sand Lord, the nature of the Dor on Taldain, and the fundamental principles of investiture that connect all worlds in the Cosmere. The fate of Dayside and Darkside intertwine as Kenton and Khriss discover that the survival of their world depends on understanding the ancient powers that shaped it.
archiveDescription: The concluding Taldain volume records the resolution of the conflict between Dayside and Darkside, and the transformation of the sand master order. The record examines the true nature of the Sand Lord and the origins of sand mastery, revealing connections between Taldain's investiture and the broader Cosmere. The off-world scholar's research yields fundamental insights into the nature of the Dor and its manifestation across different planetary environments. This accession completes the foundational survey of Taldain and its place in the Cosmere.
